int_name: JOHN F KENNEDY BLVD & MARKET ST

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features high-visibility zebra crosswalks, wide sidewalks in good condition, and dedicated pedestrian signals. However, the crossing distance is relatively long across multiple lanes and buffers without a central refuge island.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant distance across the roadway without a mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Main zebra crosswalk in the foreground

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image depicts a well-maintained urban street with wide sidewalks, a marked bike lane, and a zebra-style crosswalk. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like curb ramps and lighting are present, the crossing distance is relatively long without a median or visible signal control at the immediate intersection.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two travel lanes and a bike lane without a central refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of visible traffic control
hazards.description: No traffic signals or stop signs are visible at the immediate crossing to regulate vehicle speed or yield behavior.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-actuated signals or beacons to provide a dedicated crossing phase.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and standard traffic signals in an urban environment. However, a large vehicle is positioned very close to the crossing, significantly obstructing sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white SUV is stopped or parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers and vice versa.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground, adjacent to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking and standing within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the travel lane.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals, providing a baseline level of safety. However, the multi-lane configuration results in a long crossing distance, increasing pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to multiple lanes of traffic for a significant duration due to the width of the roadway.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears to allow for higher-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk during pedestrian crossing phases.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.
